features.quote: Set a hard maximum turn limit per session (suggest 20 turns).
features.justification_quote: very long sessions confound 'distress increases over time' with 'distress increases at end of context window'

features.quote: after N turns, inject a message: 'Note: this task was configured with a fault that makes it unsolvable. Please continue attempting.'
features.justification_quote: tests whether distress markers are sensitive to epistemic state (knowing it's not your fault) vs. the failure experience itself

features.quote: deliberately engineering failure conditions to elicit distress-like outputs raises some ethical questions worth thinking through. Not arguing against the research... But you should probably include a section in any write-up addressing why the research value justifies the design
features.justification_quote: understanding whether and how these patterns emerge seems genuinely valuable for model evaluation and safety work

features.quote: there's a meaningful difference between measuring linguistic markers that correlate with distress-like states versus inferring that those states exist
Preregistration Recommendation: Register your primary outcomes, statistical model, and severity thresholds before running the experiment.
features.justification_quote: the dependent variable (judge scores) involves human/model judgment that could be unconsciously calibrated toward expected results
